descriptions.copy: Copy selected layers to the clipboard.
descriptions.paste: Insert clipboard content into the document.
descriptions.copyComposition: Copy the current artboard with its assets.
descriptions.duplicate: Create offset copies of selected layers and groups.
descriptions.delete: Remove selected layers or the selected effect or mask.
descriptions.group: Place selected layers inside one group.
descriptions.ungroup: Release the children of selected groups.
descriptions.selectAll: Select every layer in the current artboard.
descriptions.fit: Fit the whole artwork inside the viewport.
descriptions.reset: Show the canvas at one hundred percent.
descriptions.recenter: Center the artwork without changing zoom.
descriptions.design: Edit the visual properties of the artwork.
descriptions.animate: Open motion controls and the animation timeline.
descriptions.togglePlayback: Play or pause the motion timeline.
descriptions.toolPointer: Select, move, rotate and resize artwork.
descriptions.toolHand: Pan the canvas without moving artwork.
descriptions.toolShape: Insert a shape or vector artwork.
descriptions.toolText: Create editable typography on the canvas.
descriptions.toolWand: Select connected colors with adjustable tolerance.
descriptions.toolSegment: Remove an image’s background or cut people out of a video in one undoable action.
descriptions.importImages: Add image, video and audio files to the project.
descriptions.openPortable: Open a portable project archive or legacy JSON document.
descriptions.exportImage: Render and download the artwork or motion video.
descriptions.exportProject: Download an editable portable project archive.
descriptions.projects: Browse saved projects and recent documents.
descriptions.newProject: Create a new project with an artboard preset.
descriptions.save: Persist current changes on this device.
descriptions.addPage: Add another composition to this project.
descriptions.addTechnoArtboard: Insert the Afterhours Techno artboard preset.
descriptions.enableSnapping: Snap artwork to edges, centers and alignment guides.

effectDescriptions.blur: Soften image details and protect an area from the blur.
effectDescriptions.shadow: Cast a colored shadow behind the source.
effectDescriptions.liquify: Warp an image using a round brush: push, pinch, bloat, twirl or restore.
effectDescriptions.torn-edges: Create ragged paper cuts and high-contrast torn contours.
effectDescriptions.halftone: Reproduce tones with printed dots, circular grids and color screens.
effectDescriptions.dither: Reduce colors using ordered or diffusion-style pixel patterns.
effectDescriptions.ascii: Rebuild the image using a grid of text characters.
effectDescriptions.grayscale: Convert colors into shades of gray.
effectDescriptions.saturation: Adjust the intensity of image colors.
effectDescriptions.hue: Rotate colors around the hue wheel.
effectDescriptions.exposure: Adjust the amount of light in the image.
effectDescriptions.tint: Shift the color balance toward green or magenta.
effectDescriptions.sepia: Apply a warm brown photographic tone.
effectDescriptions.threshold: Split brightness into dark and light regions.
effectDescriptions.posterize: Reduce the number of tonal levels.
effectDescriptions.vignette: Darken or tint the edges around the image center.
effectDescriptions.ripple: Distort the image with concentric waves.
effectDescriptions.shatter: Break the artwork into displaced fragments.
effectDescriptions.flashlight: Reveal an area with a movable light.
effectDescriptions.receipt: Render the image like a printed receipt.
effectDescriptions.pink-phosphor: Apply a pink phosphor display treatment.
effectDescriptions.thermal: Map image tones to a thermal palette.
effectDescriptions.displace: Warp coordinates using a displacement texture.
effectDescriptions.terminal: Style the image like a text terminal.
effectDescriptions.pixel-sort: Sort pixel bands into flowing streaks.
effectDescriptions.transition: Animate the entrance or exit of a layer.
effectDescriptions.feather: Soft elliptical alpha falloff with editable center, radius and softness.
